title: Partial-class file splitting at the 400-line soft cap
desc: Split a C# source over the 400-line soft cap into partial classes: what to move, the mandatory Release build check, single-commit rule, and the five common mistakes.
steps: Identify problem: Source file exceeds ~400 lines. Per CLAUDE.md: split via partial class (C#), module split, or extract helper.
Categorize methods by domain: Group into logical units — main business logic vs. helper utilities vs. internal plumbing. Extract helpers (fewest dependencies).
Create secondary file: Name pattern OriginalFile.Helpers.cs or OriginalFile.Part2.cs. Both declare partial class ClassName in same namespace.
Move helper methods: Cut methods from original, paste into new file. Include used namespaces (may duplicate).
Verify line counts: wc -l OriginalFile.cs OriginalFile.Helpers.cs. Original <400, new 50-200 typical. Total ≈ original + 5 lines.
Build verification (MANDATORY): dotnet build path/to/project.sln -c Release → 0 errors (warnings OK). Must complete in <300 seconds.
Commit (single): Both files in one commit. Message includes split reason + 'partial-class' keyword for suggest resolve.
Example: fix(taskkill): split TaskkillCompatCommand into partial classes for parent-process-ancestry validation
Recursive splitting: If secondary file still >400 lines, apply pattern again (Part2.cs, Part3.cs).

Avoid mistakes: (1) Moving only 10 lines (too small). (2) Splitting cohesive group (defeats clarity). (3) Missing using statements (undefined types). (4) No build check (errors hide). (5) Changing namespace (breaks partial class).

REQUIREMENT EXPECTATIONS WERE EMPTY (fixed 2026-07-23 audit): this skill shipped with 3 requirement commands and NO expected output, so nothing could ever validate them -- an unverifiable requirement is worse than none because the evidence gate reports it as present. Expected results are: (1) 'wc -l' on the split pair => BOTH files under 400 lines, and their sum within a few lines of the pre-split original (no code dropped -- the exact failure mode that lost ~320 lines in the SuggestCommand.Resolve split); (2) 'dotnet build -c Release' => '0 error(s)', warnings acceptable, under 300s; (3) 'grep namespace' on both files => the SAME namespace AND the same 'partial class' name, since a changed namespace silently breaks the partial-class join. See also wksplit-cs-utility for the automated splitter and its six safety gates.
